# Document extraction dependencies

- PDF.js 6.1.200, standalone build from unpdf 1.8.1 (`dist/pdfjs.mjs`).
- PDF.js character maps and standard fonts from the local pdfjs-dist distribution.
- JSZip 3.10.2 (`dist/jszip.min.js`), used to read the Word document XML.

The application loads these assets locally. See the accompanying licenses.
